skill1: Activates when attacking with Full Charge and self is in Maillard status. Affects all allies. Maillard Duration ▲ 2.5 sec.
Activates when attacking with Full Charge and self is in Blanching status. Affects all allies. Blanching Duration ▲ 2.5 sec.
skill2: Activates after performing 3 normal, non-Full-Charge attacks.
Affects all allies not in Reliable Cooking status.

caveats: ⚑ TWO-STATUS TOGGLE MODELED AS `modes` (default `blanching`). Maillard is granted by 3 NON-full-charge normals and Blanching by 3 maintained Full Charges, and each REMOVES the other, so exactly one is live at a time. The engine fires a charge RL at full charge, so the Blanching branch is the reachable one — hence the default. `maillard` mode is declared so the branch is reachable if the owner rules Crust is played tap-firing, but the engine cannot reproduce the DPS cost of tap-firing, so the maillard mode over-credits Crust's own shot damage.
⚑ The Maillard vs Blanching choice is a LARGE burst swing (Distributed Damage ▲60% vs Sustained Damage ▲10%). Mode choice must be settled from footage before any board reading is trusted.

⚑ Trigger proxy: both status grants use `hitCount:3` (3 rounds). The kit's Blanching branch says '3 Full Charge ... more than 1 sec'; the '>1 sec' HOLD after reaching Full Charge is not modeled (the engine releases at full charge + release latency), so the real cadence may be slower than modeled and buff uptime slightly over-credited.

⚑ 'DEF ▲ 10% of the skill user's DEF' has no caster-scaled DEF StatKey; modeled as `defPct:10` (target's own DEF). `defPct` is inert for damage in v1, so the approximation moves nothing today — it is kept for kit completeness and any future consumer.
⚑ 'Removes 1 debuff' has no ally-cleanse primitive and no debuffs exist in v1 scope — skipped, damage-neutral.

⚑ 'Affects all allies NOT in Reliable Cooking status' is a NO-REFRESH gate: the DEF buff cannot be re-applied while live, so it lapses at 10s and only re-applies on the next trigger. The model refreshes instead, over-stating uptime in the gaps (inert while defPct is inert).

⚑ The skill-2 Full-Burst-enter ATK ▲20% is gated on the target being in Maillard OR Blanching. With grants every ~3 rounds and a 10s window, status uptime is assumed ~100% at FB entry, so the gate is dropped. If Crust's opening 3 rounds land after the first Full Burst, the first proc is over-credited.
⚑ 'Affects all allies' assumed to INCLUDE self (no excludeSelf).

⚑ Crust's skill1 (casterAtkPct 10) and skill2 (casterAtkPct 20) are separate NAMED in-game buffs but the same stat from the same caster; if the buff engine's same-caster-slot overwrite collapses them, the team loses the 10% grant while the 20% is live. Verify with a buffApply event trace before trusting magnitude.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Crust (RL/Water/Supporter/Burst II) is a pure team buffer — the kit carries NO damage effect of its own (no flatDamage/dot/storedHit), so every line here is a stat or damage-bucket grant to allies. Structure: a mutually-exclusive two-status toggle (Maillard from 3 non-full-charge normals / Blanching from 3 maintained Full Charges, each removing the other) drives an identical ATK ▲10% of the skill user's ATK grant either way, plus a status-independent Reliable Cooking DEF grant, plus a Full-Burst-enter ATK ▲20% of the skill user's ATK gated on holding either status. The burst gives all allies Attack Damage ▲20% unconditionally and then a status-branched bucket buff — Distributed Damage ▲60% under Maillard, Sustained Damage ▲10% under Blanching. Because the two statuses are mutually exclusive and the ATK magnitudes are identical, the toggle only matters for the BURST branch; it is modeled with `modes` (first = default `blanching`, the branch a charge RL actually reaches in the engine) rather than by implementing both branches unconditionally, which would double-credit. Duration-extension lines (+2.5 sec per Full Charge while in status) have no buff-extension primitive and are unmodeled; with a ~3-round grant cadence against a 10s window the extension is expected to be near-redundant.

flags.estimate: Blanching (full-charge branch) live; Maillard branch inert
flags.reasoning: Maillard requires 3 NON-full-charge normal attacks; the engine fires a charge weapon at full charge with no tap-fire concept, so only the Blanching branch is reachable in-sim. The two branches grant identical ATK magnitudes, so the choice only changes the BURST bucket buff — Distributed ▲60% (Maillard) vs Sustained ▲10% (Blanching), a large swing.
flags.recipe: Watch a Crust recording: count charge-bar completions vs quick taps in the first magazine, and read which burst banner/status icon is on the team at burst time. If she is played tap-firing, switch the default mode to 'maillard' AND open a separate gap for the unmodeled DPS cost of tap-firing a charge RL (the engine will still fire full charges).

flags.estimate: 3 rounds ≈ 3 full charges; first grant ~3-4s into the fight
flags.reasoning: Kit says '3 Full Charge status ... more than 1 sec'. hitCount counts ROUNDS (hitsPerShot 1), so 3 rounds = 3 full-charge shots — but the kit's '>1 sec' MAINTENANCE of Full Charge after the bar completes is not modeled (the engine releases at full charge + the measured 22-frame latency). If a real hold exists, the grant cadence is slower than modeled and buff uptime is over-credited.
flags.recipe: Frame-count a recording from charge-bar-full to shot release. If release is ~immediate, hitCount:3 is faithful. If there is a ~1s hold, the effective cadence per grant is 3×(chargeTime + 1s + fire) and the model needs a slower trigger (or an interval proxy pinned to the measured period).

flags.estimate: ~1.0s charge, ~2.35s reload, 6 rounds/magazine → a grant roughly every ~3-4s
flags.reasoning: Datamined cadence fields are known-unreliable, and every grant in this kit hangs off the round counter, so cadence error propagates directly into buff UPTIME for the whole team — not just into Crust's own (zero) damage.
flags.recipe: Count Crust's shots and reloads over a 30s window of footage (ammo counter is the direct instrument for shots/sec — not full-burst counts, which are downstream of gauge). Compare against the datamined tuple and pin the measured value.

flags.estimate: 10 (target's own DEF %), as a stand-in for 10% of the CASTER's DEF
flags.reasoning: No caster-scaled DEF StatKey exists (casterAtkPct has no DEF analogue). defPct is inert for damage in v1, so the approximation is damage-neutral today; kept per the rule that DEF/HP/shield/heal lines are never skipped on isolation, since a future consumer or a DEF-scaling teammate could read it.
flags.recipe: No measurement needed while defPct is inert. If a DEF-scaling consumer ever lands, add a casterDefPct StatKey rather than re-tuning this value.

flags.field: skill2 block 2 (FB-enter ATK ▲20%) — dropped status gate
flags.estimate: ~100% status uptime at Full Burst entry
flags.reasoning: The kit gates the 20% on the ally holding Maillard or Blanching. With a grant every ~3 rounds against a 10s window, status should be continuously up after Crust's first three shots — so the gate is expected to be satisfied on every FB. The exception is a Full Burst that lands before Crust has fired 3 rounds (an opening-rotation FB), where the model over-credits.
flags.recipe: From footage, timestamp Crust's 3rd round vs the first Full Burst entry. If the first FB precedes it, gate the block behind a measured delay or accept the documented first-proc over-credit.

flags.estimate: ≈0 net effect (grant cadence already shorter than the 10s window)
flags.reasoning: Each full-charge attack while in status extends that status by 2.5s, but the status is re-granted every ~3 rounds against a 10s duration, so the base window should already cover the gap. The extension only matters if the real trigger cadence is materially slower than modeled (see the cadence ⚑).
flags.recipe: Only revisit if the measured grant cadence exceeds ~10s per proc; then the ATK buff has real downtime the extension was covering, and a longer durationSec (measured, not fitted) becomes the right encoding.

flags.estimate: Includes self (excludeSelf not set) on every block
flags.reasoning: The kit says 'Affects all allies' with no '(except self)' qualifier, which in this schema maps to allies without excludeSelf. Crust deals no kit damage, so self-inclusion only matters for her own weapon damage.
flags.recipe: Compare Crust's own recorded damage against a sim run with and without excludeSelf on the skill1/skill2 ATK grants; the delta is the whole test.

flags.estimate: Both live simultaneously (30% of caster ATK total during the FB window)
flags.reasoning: In game these are distinct named buffs (the status buff vs the FB-enter buff), but they share stat + caster. If the buff engine's same-caster-slot overwrite keys only on (caster, stat), the 20% would replace the 10% and the team loses 10% of Crust's ATK for the whole FB window — a real magnitude error, not a rounding one.
flags.recipe: Run the comp with cfg.onEvent, filter buffApply for stat 'casterAtkPct' with casterIdx = Crust's slot, and check that two distinct keys are live across a Full Burst window (values are flat-resolved: 0.10×staticAtk and 0.20×staticAtk). If they collapse, the blocks need distinct keys.
